status: 수정 시안 / 사용자 피드백 대기 / 게임 적용 및 웹 빌드 없음
feedback: 기존 캐릭터는 너무 고해상도·잘생긴 보통 인상. 개성 있고 우스꽝스럽게 생긴 군인, 기분 나쁜 훈련병, 팬 볼과 불타는 눈. 난이도 별에도 디지털 위장무늬.
result: 과장된 얼굴과 실루엣, 세 인물 비교, 위장무늬 별 시안. A/B는 다른 상대의 개성 비교용이며 계급·난이도 배정은 미확정.
limits: 도트풍 생성 이미지. 실제 스프라이트의 픽셀 격자, 팔레트 수, 투명도, 작은 화면 가독성은 게임 적용 단계 검증 전. 현지화 텍스트는 최종 자산에 구워 넣지 않음.
prompt:
Use case: style-transfer / original game-character concept sheet.
Input image 1 is the REJECTED previous concept. Completely redesign its generic handsome soldier and excessively detailed rendering. Preserve only the idea of adult military opponents wearing patrol caps and digital camouflage T-shirts, sitting at a desk with BOTH elbows on its top. Do NOT preserve the old face, anatomy, smooth rendering or UI layout. This new sheet focuses on characters and camouflage difficulty stars, not a phone screenshot.

Create a clean landscape character concept sheet with THREE clearly different, ORIGINAL comically ugly adult soldier rivals, waist-up behind simple desks, one large primary character on the left half, and two smaller complete upper-body studies on the right half. All have cap, chest, both arms and both elbows visible. Plain pale warm-paper background and lots of breathing room. Minimal Korean labels: large left “훈련병”; two right studies simply “A”, “B”. One bottom strip labeled “난이도” with three identical CAMOUFLAGE-FILLED five-point stars.

STYLE IS THE MAIN CORRECTION: genuinely COARSE LOW-RES PIXEL ART. Aim for each full upper-body sprite designed on about a 96×96 logical-pixel grid, enlarged with NEAREST NEIGHBOR; giant clean square pixel clusters, bold stepped silhouettes, 1–2 logical-pixel dark outlines, flat 12–16 color palette, only two skin shadow tones. The face must remain readable at small game size. No high-resolution illustration pretending to be pixel art, no painterly texture, no fine dithering, no gradients, no realistic shading, no soft edges, no beauty-rendered anime hero. Simple chunky arcade-game caricatures with memorable asymmetric proportions. Colors: ink brown, olive, khaki, muted green, dull tan skin, and tiny hot orange/yellow accents ONLY in the recruit's burning eyes. Digital camouflage uses a few large rectangular patches, not noisy realistic micro-patterns.

PRIMARY RECRUIT: a hilariously sour, frustrated and intensely competitive young ADULT man who is clearly having a bad day. Thin angular face, deeply SUNKEN CHEEKS indicated with bold dark planes, protruding uneven cheekbones, a long off-center wedge-shaped chin, a crooked broad hooked nose, large protruding ears, a pinched lopsided downturned mouth with one little tooth visible, uneven heavy eyebrows. Wide bloodshot-looking white eyes with tiny hot orange/yellow flame-like pixel pupils, glaring at the player with absurd over-the-top determination. One brow higher, forehead crease, tiny sweat square: irritated, disgruntled and funny. Not handsome, not cool, not conventionally heroic, not generic angry anime. His peculiar face must be the central appeal. Create an ORIGINAL silhouette, not a recognizable manga/anime character. Body is awkward and wiry rather than muscular; slightly hunched with both elbows planted on the desk, bony hands resting near each other. Rumpled original digital-camo T-shirt and slightly crooked patrol cap with a readable short brim. No literal fire obscuring the face, no horror, no injury.

RIGHT STUDY A: a different adult rival with an extremely broad squashed rectangular head, huge low cheeks, almost invisible squinting eyes, tiny nose, and an absurd smug sideways pout; compact heavy body, cap too flat. Both elbows on his own simple desk. Comically unattractive and distinct from the recruit.
RIGHT STUDY B: a different adult rival with a tall egg-shaped head, huge buck teeth, tiny chin, one drooping eye and one raised eyebrow, conspicuously big ears and tired suspicious expression; long thin neck, narrow shoulders. Both elbows on his own simple desk. Distinct from both other characters.
They are personality caricatures of invented individuals, not an ethnic or national caricature. No national flags, official insignia, real unit marks or recognizable existing character costumes.

DIFFICULTY STARS: near bottom, three LARGE matching five-point pixel stars, sharp blocky silhouettes with a thick dark border and thin pale rim, filled with LARGE digital-camouflage squares in olive, sage and khaki. No golden/yellow star fill, no glossy embossed metal, no tiny muddy patterns. Their outlines must remain easy to read at a small mobile UI size. Star color/design belongs to the same low-resolution game assets as the characters.
Avoid a full game UI, boards, screens, other labels, weapons, merchandise, logos, realistic beautiful faces or complex scenic background. This sheet is an intentionally simple, expressive, coarse-pixel redesign for feedback.
